entrepreneurial orientation is more strongly related to organizational learning in large firms and to business performance in SMEs.

entrepreneurial orientation and learning orientations are positively related to business performance through organizational learning and that this relationship is stronger in large firms than in SMEs.
entrepreneurial orientation and organizational performance are related to organizational learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the influence of the organizational culture on the organizational learning process and the relationship between organizational learning and business performance.

the influence of entrepreneurial and learning orientation on business performance and the role of organizational learning as a mediating factor in the relationships between these two cultural values and performance, as well as the influence of organizational size as a moderator of these relationships.
the study of organizational learning as a mediating and moderating variable in the relationship between the entrepreneurial and learning orientations and business performance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the entrepreneurial orientation of a company is positively related to its business performance, but only through its influence on organizational learning and, especially, for large companies.
the relationship between entrepreneurial and learning orientation and business performance is partially mediated by organizational learning, which is more intense in large companies than in SMEs.
entrepreneurial orientation has a positive effect on organizational learning, and that this effect is moderated by the organizational size.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the entrepreneurial orientation is a key driver for organizational learning and, consequently, for business performance in large firms, while the learning orientation is the most relevant antecedent for organizational learning and business performance in SMEs.
the influence of entrepreneurial and learning orientations is more relevant for large firms than for SMEs, and that this influence is more intense in SMEs in the case of learning orientation.
entrepreneurial orientation and learning culture are both necessary but not enough to achieve business performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between entrepreneurial and learning orientation and organizational learning depends on the organizational size.

, although the influence of entrepreneurial and learning orientation on the performance is similar for SMEs and large firms, the way in which these antecedent values affect performance is not the same for both organizational sizes.
the influence of entrepreneurial and learning orientations on performance is not direct, but it is mediated by organizational learning.
